exposure: Maternal pre-pregnancy hepatitis B virus infection (HBsAg positive and HBeAg negative)
Maternal pre-pregnancy hepatitis B virus infection (HBsAg and HBeAg positive)
cohort: The study included 489,965 rural Chinese women aged 21-49 years who had singleton livebirths and participated in the National Free Preconception Health Examination Project.
finding: Maternal pre-pregnancy hepatitis B virus infection was independently associated with a significantly higher risk of both preterm birth (20-26% higher risk) and early preterm birth (18-34% higher risk).
